title: From the Heel of Italy
tagline: From the heel of Italy to the nations
description: Updates from the Pieno Vangelo ministry and the Ronchi family: our church in Modugno, Il Rifugio, missions and church planting across Puglia and beyond.
author: Pastor Mirko Ronchi

areas.name: Family Life
areas.intro: Personal news from Pastor Mirko and the Ronchi family. Here you'll find what God is doing in our home, how we are doing and how you can pray for us.

areas.name: Church Life
areas.intro: Pieno Vangelo (Full Gospel) Church in Modugno, near Bari, was born in the 1970s through the work of Dutch missionaries. Here you'll find news on initiatives and the vision we are pursuing for our city and beyond.

areas.name: Welcoming Immigrants to Christ
areas.intro: Many families come to Puglia from far away in search of a better life. We long to welcome them with the love of Christ, through friendship and practical help. Here you'll find stories of the people God is bringing to our doorstep.

areas.name: Plant & Strengthen
areas.intro: Many towns in Puglia still have no living church. We plant new churches and stand alongside existing ones that need support to keep going. Here you'll find news from these churches and the people who lead them.

areas.name: To the Ends of the Earth
areas.intro: We send workers beyond our borders and prepare young people to go. Here you'll find news on training, departures and stories from those we send.

areas.name: Il Rifugio Center
areas.intro: Set among pine woods and olive groves in the countryside of Ruvo di Puglia, Il Rifugio is a place of welcome and refreshment at the service of churches and ministries. Through camps, conferences and retreats, guests are renewed in body and spirit, workers for the harvest are trained and helped to grow, and the Church is built up. Here you'll find news of what God is doing there.
